title: Row Locks, Gap Locks, and Next-Key Locks knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Row Locks, Gap Locks, and Next-Key Locks”?
options: It guarantees correct output regardless of schema, permissions, or release version.
It is best handled by removing constraints and skipping error checks.

A transaction groups related data changes into a single reliability boundary. Isolation and locking affect what concurrent sessions can see or change; keep transactions short and design retries so the same business action is not applied twice.
It is a frontend styling feature and does not involve database behavior.
questions.answer_key: A transaction groups related data changes into a single reliability boundary. Isolation and locking affect what concurrent sessions can see or change; keep transactions short and design retries so the same business action is not applied twice.

questions.prompt: Which practice best applies “Row Locks, Gap Locks, and Next-Key Locks” safely?

Concatenate untrusted input into SQL text and grant administrator privileges to every application user.
questions.answer_key: Describe two-session behavior for a small transaction, then test commit/rollback and one conflict in a disposable database.
questions.explanation: Describe two-session behavior for a small transaction, then test commit/rollback and one conflict in a disposable database. This makes the result reviewable and aligns with a controlled learning workflow.
